description: Allegion plc engages in the provision of security products and solutions worldwide. It is operating through two segments: Allegion Americas and Allegion International. The company offers door controls, door control system, and exit devices; doors, glass and door systems, and…
transcript_take: Q1 2026 was mixed: adjusted EPS fell $0.06 / 3.2% to $1.80 as acquisition EPS was more than offset by higher tax, interest and other; revenue rose 9.7% reported / +2.6% organic led by strong Americas nonres (+4.5% organic; spec activity called 'very strong, broad-based'), but adjusted operating margin dropped 150 bps to 21.2% on volume/mix and Allegion International fell 5.3% organic on an ERP implementation disruption in a legacy European mechanical business. Management AFFIRMED FY2026 guidance (organic 2-4%, adjusted EPS $8.70-$8.90) and raised the reported-revenue outlook 1 pt to 6-8% to include the DCI acquisition, while flagging ~1 pt-of-COGS incremental tariff/inflation to be offset dollar-neutral via price — real positives (nonres strength, guide affirmed) against a genuine EPS/margin dip and an International execution miss.
mda_take: FY2025 (10-K) net revenues rose 7.8% to $4,067.3M on pricing +3.1%, M&A +3.1%, volume +1.0% and FX +0.6%, with tariffs (est. 20-25% of COGS from Mexico) offset by price; Allegion Americas grew 6.9% to $3,218.8M at a 27.9% operating margin (up from 27.1%) and International grew 11.7% to $848.5M at a 9.0% margin, lifting total operating margin to 21.1% and diluted EPS to $7.44 (from $6.82). The effective tax rate rose to 16.2% (from 14.5%) on Global Minimum Tax/jurisdictional mix; 2025 acquisitions totaled ~$631.6M (incl. ELATEC, closed July 1, 2025). The FY read is intact — margins and EPS both up — with tax drift the main muting factor.
